settings.order: Five paired rounds, alternating before/after order; no concurrent local profiling or tests.

variants: ordinary ASCII with wide and combining characters
mixed-case identifiers with wide and combining characters
largeSearch.setup: Rendered layout and initial query warmed before timing.

largeWriter.setup: New view, parsing, and destination allocation included in each operation.

method: Identical final benchmark sources run against current application files and a Go overlay of search.go and view.go from the pinned baseline.
validation: 100000 differential search cases, including custom cell widths
10000 differential writer streams with arbitrary write boundaries
Both affected branch tips pass build, unit tests, and lint.
limits: Synthetic operation timings, not whole-application or Git/terminal latency measurements.
Single Linux machine and one CPU; results do not establish cross-platform gains.
Search excludes initial result growth and layout construction; writer includes new destination allocations.

controlRecheck.reason: The initial three-sample editor controls were ordered before then after and showed a possible short-input slowdown.
controlRecheck.conclusion: Seven paired repeats have overlapping timing ranges and median changes under 2%; no material editor or paste slowdown was observed in these fixtures.

rejectedPrototype.description: Track a candidate match column instead of keeping the position ring.
rejectedPrototype.outcome: Little timing benefit, with a slowdown in one query-lifetime case; not shipped.
